text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thx a lot... wait, no.
Huh? Much obliged...? No, that's not it either...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh!
I messed up again! No, not like that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was about to enter the trainer's office,
I heard a troubled voice.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "I definitely shouldn't write while talking! I'm ending up writing in total party-animal speak!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Change of venue! Let's go somewhere we can't talk!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Sitting in silence isn't making any ideas come to meee!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Going somewhere with no one around won't help at aaaaall!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, Daitaku Helios could be seen fretting all over the academy grounds—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pyyyyeeeeeeh~~~! Trainy~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "A letteeeer!! I can't write a single thiiing!!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Daitaku Helios,
I am an 80-year-old woman."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, there's a lot I don't understand
about the things Helios-chan says. But
whenever I see your smile—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Even if words don't carry across, they bring a smile.
Please continue to stay happy, healthy,
and full of laughter. Sincerely,』
choice_data_list: So you're writing a reply to that letter...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But no matter how many times I try to write it, it's so hard.
It always ends up sounding like party-animal slang!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then wouldn't Grandma have no clue
what to make of it if she received it!?
choice_data_list: I think they'd be happy with Helios just being her usual self, though.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No, that's not gonna cut it this time!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I treasure ev-ery-one who treasures me!
I luvvv all of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"If they went out of their way to write a letter, that means they wanna connect with me, right?
Then I gotta answer back!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I want to give back what I've received,
and it makes me happy when I can!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So no matter what, I'm hitting back!
A response to every call! A reaction to every taunt!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'll show you my party-girl pride, you bet I will!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While one couldn't say she ran purely on vibes alone,
Daitaku Helios treated everyone with the same upbeat
attitude and youth slang without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, she also seems to have a genuine desire to treat anyone who reaches out to her with sincerity...
choice_data_list: Let's write a letter that really gets your feelings across together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Thanx, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Btw, this is our last sheet of stationery from redos!
Seriously cannot mess this up, so good luck☆
choice_data_list: ...First, let's draft it on your phone!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
!!!!!!!!!
Are you a geeeeenius?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was nervous while transcribing it, but thanks to that, I was able to mail it out without issue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turned out to be a great opportunity to understand
Daitaku Helios's perspective on socializing with people.
